name: Input
description: Single-line text field. Works for every native input type (text, email, search, number, file…).

default.looks: Wash fill, 1px line-strong border, control radius; placeholder in muted at 70%.

pressed.none: Text fields have no pressed look; the caret shows where you are.

focus.looks: 2px ring drawn just inside the edge (-1px offset); the border goes transparent.

error.looks: Border 60% destructive; the focus ring turns destructive. Forced colours: dashed border.

loading.none: No loading look. While a value is checked (a username), use an Input group with a small Spinner as its addon.

scale.sm: Control sm height (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch), tighter padding, sm text.
scale.md: Control md height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch).
scale.lg: Control lg height (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), more padding, lg text.

sizes.density: Height and text size follow data-density; touch keeps md text at 16px so iOS doesn't zoom.
sizes.width: Fills its container (inline-size 100%); set a max-inline-size in rem for short values.

props.size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" (visual size; native size attr not exposed)

a11y: Every input needs a label: wrap in a Field with a Label (for/id), or aria-label for search boxes.
Errors: aria-invalid="true" + aria-describedby pointing at the error text.
do: Use an input for short free-text entry: names, URLs, search, API keys.

Use type="date", "time" or "datetime-local" for dates and times: the browser's own picker, in the theme's colour scheme, with keyboard entry and the user's locale. Set min and max for bookable ranges.
Match the input size to neighbouring buttons in a toolbar (sm with sm).
dont: Don't use an input for multi-line text — use Textarea.
Don't use an input for on/off — use Switch.
Don't use placeholder as the label.
Don't hardcode widths in px inside flexible layouts — the input fills its container.
